scientific_integrity: A proof and deterministic finite-matrix cross-check are supplied; the computational examples do not certify the infinite-family theorem. Historical-priority comparison is incomplete for one plausible inaccessible article.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite unweighted cycles, one localized absorber with positive fixed strength, uniform independent site dephasing, no competing background recombination; joint scaling limits and full distribution not established.
title: Universal weak-dephasing absorption clock on finite quantum cycles
